summary: End-to-end testing of the new Share Cards feature. All 8 backend pytest cases pass and full frontend flow (visit ?shared={id} -> answer displays -> Share popover -> preview image + link + copy toast + X + Save) works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: share_image.render_card is a blocking (CPU) PIL call executed inside the async /api/s/{sid}/image.png handler; on higher concurrency this will block the event loop. Consider wrapping with run_in_executor or asyncio.to_thread.

POST /api/share does not validate that the caller-supplied result is one produced by the server; a client could store arbitrary content and generate misleading share images. Consider signing results or regenerating shortAnswer server-side.
No rate limiting or size guard on /api/share; question is untrimmed on max length in this endpoint (only trimmed). Add length validation similar to AnswerRequest.
share_page uses request.headers.get('x-forwarded-host') without validating; a spoofed Host header could poison og:image URL for a scraper. Consider using an APP_BASE_URL env var instead.

ShareButton save-image-button uses <a target='_blank' download>, but combined with target='_blank' most browsers ignore 'download' — clicking Save opens the PNG in a new tab rather than downloading. Minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: Created share id 'ka8qaUXB' via POST /api/share (question: 'Should I learn Python in 2026?') for frontend ?shared testing. Additional TEST_-prefixed shares created by pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend share endpoints are covered by /app/backend/tests/test_share.py. Frontend ShareButton flow verified via Playwright on ?shared={id}. Known good share id: ka8qaUXB. If retesting X/Save UX, note that 'Save' opens PNG in new tab (target=_blank) instead of forcing download.
